newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Director sells 3.85 mln Indesen shares.
newsitem.headline: Director sells 3.85 mln Indesen shares.

text.p: Video cassette manufacturer Indesen Industries Co Ltd said on Monday one of the company's directors, Patrick Lam, had sold 3.85 million of the company's shares at HK$0.126 to HK$0.18 each.
Indesen said the shares were sold between September 10 to 13.
Chairman Ali Simin held 99 million shares or 39.52 percent of Indesen Industries as in January 1996, and Lam owned 35.05 million shares or 13.99 percent.
The shares ended at HK$0.128 on Friday, up HK$0.002, on volume of 3.72 million shares. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
